einzeiler: Comedian Canise Mobley shares her wild dating adventures and limits of saying yes abroad.
kurzfassung: Comedian Canise Mobley reflects on her solo travels and dating experiences across Europe, influenced by romantic movie tropes. She recounts a memorable, bizarre date in Paris that escalated from a museum visit to a sex club and pizza dinner. Through these encounters, she learns to balance the thrill of saying yes with her personal boundaries and identity.
stichpunkte: Solo travel expectations are often shaped by romantic movies promising transformative European encounters.
Canise started solo traveling after travel disagreements with her mother escalated into tense situations.
Dating abroad offers a sense of anonymity and freedom from domestic social dynamics and expectations.
Screening dates while traveling involves safety measures like sharing profiles and notifying friends.
A Paris date led to an unexpected visit to a clandestine sex club featuring group encounters and pizza.
The experience in the sex club shattered the cinematic fantasy and highlighted underlying social realities.
Subsequent late-night dinner conversation revealed the mundane humanity behind the travel fantasy.
Canise advises maintaining twenty-five percent flexibility with personal boundaries when exploring abroad.

beschreibung:
How far can "yes" take you before it stops feeling like freedom? Comedian Kenice Mobley grew up on rom-coms where a woman flies to Europe, accepts an invitation from a man with high cheekbones, and gets a whole new life. So when a flirt in Paris turns into an invitation, Kenice follows it... straight into an underground world that asks her to keep saying "yes". She does, right up until she hits the edge of it: the line between freedom and fantasy.
Follow Kenice at @kenicemobley and get tickets to her show, "Hot Guy Draft" on August 23rd, 2026 at Littlefield in Brooklyn.
